statement: A claimed invention that was patented, described in a printed publication, in public use, on sale, or otherwise available to the public before its effective filing date is unpatentable, except that a disclosure made 1 year or less before the effective filing date is not prior art if it was made by the inventor, a joint inventor, or another who obtained the subject matter from the inventor (35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1), (b)(1)(A)).
caveat: Most foreign patent systems have no equivalent grace period, so a public launch or demo before any filing can forfeit non-US rights immediately. Commercial offers for sale, even confidential ones, can trigger the on-sale bar. This repo does not assess patentability.
